reviews.title: Don’t invest
reviews.text:
I bought Home Design 3D: Gold Edition because it was a one-time purchase. I was happy to pay for the app and even spent additional money on content because I thought I was investing in a product I could keep using.

Now, the Gold Edition has been removed and replaced with a subscription model that costs $80 a year. I get that developers need to make money, but this price is just too high for me. An annual subscription for a home design app is simply too much, especially when many of us originally picked the Gold Edition because it was not subscription-based.

What makes this especially frustrating is that I wasn’t expecting everything to be free. I would have happily paid for a reasonably priced upgrade, bought optional furniture or decor packs, or even purchased a new version as a one-time deal. Instead, the only option now is an expensive recurring subscription.

It feels like loyal customers who supported the original app have been left behind. Those of us who paid for the Gold Edition and put extra money into the app deserved a more customer-friendly upgrade path than being asked to pay $80 annually.

I genuinely loved this app, which is why writing this review is so disappointing. I still think it’s a great piece of software, but I can’t back a pricing model that turns what was once an affordable, one-time purchase into an ongoing yearly expense.

It’s sad to walk away from an app I truly enjoyed, but I won’t support a pricing model that forces loyal customers into an ex

reviews.title: It’s a scam
reviews.text:
This game used to be genuinely great. About five years ago, I paid for the Gold edition, which gave me access to all of the features. I was a loyal paying customer and had built up years’ worth of projects that I enjoyed coming back to.

When the app changed in June and new features were placed behind a subscription, I was disappointed, but I understood that apps evolve and developers need to make money. I simply stopped creating new projects and continued enjoying the projects I had already made and paid for.

Now, however, the app has become essentially unusable without a subscription—and, even worse, many of my old projects that I had kept for years are gone. That is completely unacceptable. I paid for this app and invested years of time into creating those projects, only to have access to them taken away.

What makes this even more frustrating is the complete lack of meaningful customer support. Please don’t respond with a generic “Thanks for your review” or pretend that this isn’t happening. Actually listen to what longtime customers are saying. Loyal users who supported this app years ago deserve better than having the experience they paid for gradually stripped away.

There are other house-design games out there, such as Planner 5D, that offer a much better experience. At this point, I would strongly encourage people to think twice before investing money or years of work into this app, because there is no guarantee that features you have access to today won’t be locked

reviews.title: THIS APP JUST ROBBED ITS OWN LOYAL USER
reviews.text:
If you’re thinking about downloading this app, RUN. Don’t walk. Don’t hesitate. RUN.

I’ve used Home Design 3D for nearly TEN YEARS. I paid for the full version back when that actually meant something. I’ve used it for renovations, room planning, everything. And now? The developers woke up one morning and decided to hold every long-time user’s work hostage behind a ridiculous paywall — $80 a YEAR or $20 a MONTH for an app that used to be a simple one-time purchase.

And the best part? They didn’t even bother making sure existing accounts WORK. I can’t log in. I can’t reset my password. The reset email never comes. All my designs — a decade of work — are just LOCKED AWAY unless I cough up subscription money for something I ALREADY OWNED.

This isn’t an “update.” It’s not an “improvement.”
It’s a full-on cash grab dressed up as a “new feature.”

They didn’t grandfather old users in.
They didn’t communicate anything.
They just quietly turned the lights off and pretended they didn’t see us.

If a company will do this to people who supported them for YEARS, imagine what they’ll do to you as a brand-new user. Don’t invest your time, your money, or your designs into something that can disappear the moment they decide they want more cash.

There are better apps out there that don’t treat their users like disposable income streams.
Save yourself the headache — and your wallet.

reviews.text: I got this app because I remember when it was wonderful on a different  iPad and wanted it on my one but now u have to have a subscription that’s like £50 a year when u use to pay ONCE like £5 and save ur project as much as u want but now u have to pay the king’s ransom just to save a project twice

reviews.title: Don’t want a subscription plan!!!
reviews.text: The only reason I chose your app over other 3D design apps about 2 years ago was that you didn’t have a subscription plan. I hate subscription plans with all my soul. I’m happy to do a one-off payment, even to pay for extra features. Now that you’re switching to subscription plans, you keep bombarding me with prompts to switch to a subscription. NO, thank you!!! And would appreciate if you stopped showing me the prompts. Until then it’s a one star from me.

reviews.title: Forced subscription
reviews.text: I bought this in good faith that it was not a subscription trap. Without any warning or fair consideration for those of us who paid full price on multiple platforms, it now wants £22 per month???? For a design app??? Horrendous. AVOID!
